X-RAY / PROOF OF GROWTH

Stage 10 — protected project saves, source-sheet lifecycle acceptance and a bounded supplier-search contract

8 September 2026 · Development browser (Vite dev server) · desktop 1280x800 and tablet 1024x768 · isolated agent-browser profiles · no build, installation or native run

What changed

Three parallel slices, each adversarially verified by three independent refuters with one repair round. The main project record now refuses stale writes, pauses when another window saves a newer revision and survives quota failures with retry (B-12, B-13, B-02 partial). Source-sheet rename, archive review and recover were exercised against the 13-page Redburn drawing with a locked scale and a real annotation, and the review now lists saved views (D-02, D-04, D-05 partial, verified in development). A server-only, credential-gated Firecrawl v2 search contract with strict response validation and truthful failure states was added to the Cost pane; no live request was made (P-01 dependency-blocked; P-02, P-09, P-10 partial). Full A–Z rows stay open; this is development proof only.
